skill_name: Explain the effects of automation on job trends.
workflow: Automation has had a profound effect on job trends, as it has resulted in both the creation of new job opportunities and the loss of jobs that have become automated. Automation has created more efficient processes for a variety of tasks and businesses, which has resulted in increased productivity and cost savings.
